title: Sentinel DevOS Foundation Manifest
description: Static, machine-readable repository-foundation manifest introduced by S2 (ML-DEVOS-RFC-001, ML-DEVOS-AS-006, D-016). Descriptive metadata only -- not a Task Engine, Policy Engine, Orchestrator, runtime loader, or enforcement mechanism. Strictly subordinate to the frozen architecture (ML-DEVOS-ARCH-001), the active governance-capability baseline, brain/DECISION_LOG.md decisions, ADRs, and durable Architect Syncs -- this manifest may summarize or reference those records; it may never redefine, weaken, or override them.

architecture_baseline.description: The frozen S0 architecture. MUST remain distinct from sentinel_capability_baseline (S2-F001 / RFC acceptance criterion 2).

sentinel_capability_baseline.description: The active Sentinel governance-capability baseline (S1 Governance Kernel, closed at v1.3.0 by D-013/ML-DEVOS-ADR-001). MUST remain distinct from architecture_baseline.

source_of_truth_precedence.description: Ordered, highest authority first. Must place the frozen architecture, active governance kernel, decisions, ADRs, and durable Architect Syncs above this manifest, and this manifest above the project registry index (S2-F002).

owning_phase.description: Exactly one canonical owning phase per root (S2-F005). Never an array -- a root with more than one owner is a modeling error, not a valid state.

consuming_phases.description: Phases that may consume this root's artifacts once implemented, without owning or redefining the root.

status.description: NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every root reserved for a later phase not yet closed. FOUNDATION_ACTIVE only for devos/schemas/, which S2 itself owns and populates. IMPLEMENTED (ML-DEVOS-RFC-015 / ML-DEVOS-AS-059 / D-044 / D-045) means the owning phase's bounded repository capability has been built, independently reviewed, and closed under an explicit Paulo decision -- it is descriptive only and grants no authority, does not imply deployment/runtime verification (CORE-007/016/017/018 are untouched by this field), and does not itself authorize any later phase (reserved_root_invariant remains in force).

closure_ref.description: ML-DEVOS-RFC-015 / ML-DEVOS-AS-059 / D-044 / D-045: optional fail-closed link to this root's closure event. Absent or null for NOT_IMPLEMENTED/FOUNDATION_ACTIVE (a root that has not closed cannot cite a closure event). For IMPLEMENTED, must be a non-null string matching an ML-DEVOS-ADR-NNN identifier that resolves to exactly one devos-manifest.json closure_history[] entry whose own 'adr' field equals this value, whose 'phase' field equals this root's own 'owning_phase', and whose 'decision'/'architect_sync'/'version' fields are all non-empty and structurally valid -- enforced by validate-devos-manifest.mjs, not by this static schema alone (matches by adr, a unique never-reused identifier, never by phase, a reusable category label -- AS57-F002).

executable_runtime_present.description: MUST be false for every root while no later phase has genuinely added live execution. Clarified by responsibility, not invocation method (ML-DEVOS-RFC-015 / ML-DEVOS-AS-059 AS57-F005/AS58-F004): false means the root contains no active Sentinel operational subsystem that owns/persists operational state, executes lifecycle/state transitions, dispatches/orchestrates actors, brokers/enforces capabilities, or performs autonomous/consequence-bearing operational actions. Repository-local schemas, specifications, deterministic validators/generators, and their tests may be executable code and may be invoked manually or automatically (including from CI) without becoming a Sentinel runtime subsystem by that fact alone -- invocation mechanism never determines this field's value. A root may legitimately reach status IMPLEMENTED while this remains false indefinitely (S2-F007, RFC non-goals).

status.description: MUST be EMPTY throughout S2 (RFC acceptance criterion 6/7). Only a later, separately authorized PROJECT_ONBOARDING decision may make this POPULATED.

executable_runtime_present.description: MUST be false -- no Task/Policy/Capability/Orchestrator/Evidence runtime, CI enforcement, or ruleset exists at the manifest level. Clarified by responsibility, not invocation method (ML-DEVOS-RFC-015 / ML-DEVOS-AS-059): see the matching per-root field's description for the exact behavior-based definition, which applies identically here.

closure_history.description: Ledger of Sentinel phase closures recorded by this manifest. Added at S2 closure (D-017, ML-DEVOS-ADR-002); the manifest did not exist during S1's own closure, so S1's closure is recorded only in D-013/ML-DEVOS-ADR-001, not backfilled here as a fabricated entry. Append-only in spirit -- a later closure adds a new entry, it does not edit a prior one (CORE-011).
